posts.text: if there’s a deal, the united states and iran will both declare victory. heck, i’m all in favor of participation trophies if it gets the strait reopened.

a deal with iran is the least worst outcome available to president trump.
aside from not starting the war in the first place.

expected outcome of us/iran agreement:

1) strait opens and blockade dropped immediately.

2) ceasefire extended for 60-days

3) qatar transfers $6 billion of iranian assets to iran, the united states says it has nothing to do with that transfer (call it a coincidence)

4) us and iran continue (restart) negotiating nuclear issues, probably keep extending the deadline with little progress

5) no meaningful expansion of abraham accords

the united states and iran will have contradictory announcements on any agreed memorandum. 

that’s fine. as long as the strait reopens. which is looking increasingly likely (fingers crossed).
